title: Wildlife Authored Instance
description: Schema for a hand-authored wildlife instance. Wildlife are non-intelligent creatures driven by behavior trees, not the in-game LLM runtime. Distinguished from NPCs per ADR-0008. Lives in wildlife/<wildlife_id>/data.json. Most wildlife will be procgen from wildlife_template; authored instances are for unique/named creatures (e.g., a legendary beast, a specific cosmic-horror entity).

species.description: Designer category like 'wolf', 'deer', 'dire_bear', 'shoggoth'. Used for storylet preconditions and combat resolution affinities.

category.description: Top-level taxonomy. Affects damage type resistances and combat behavior.

aggression.description: Default behavior toward the player and other creatures. The behavior tree script branches on this.

behavior_tree.description: script:* URN pointing to the GDScript behavior tree implementation.

combat_stats.description: Optional. Combatant wildlife carry stats. Non-combatant or unkillable wildlife (passive observers, lore-only entities) omit. Absence means non-combatant: the engine treats the wildlife as incapable of attacking. For unkillable entities, omit combat_stats and rely on behavior_tree to handle invulnerability semantics.

active_periods.description: Time-of-day when the creature is active. Used by spawning and behavior-tree branching.

respawns.description: Whether this wildlife respawns after death. Authored unique creatures typically set false; generic wildlife defaults true.

tags.description: Optional informal tags for filtering and storylet preconditions. Tags are not centrally registered; each project documents its tag conventions in the project README. The validator only checks tag-name syntax, not semantics.
